title: Thread-safe Cache
description: An LRU cache is hammered by a mock server from many goroutines. golang's map is not thread safe under concurrent writers. Add a mutex to make it safe.
task: Change the code to make the cache thread safe, so `go test -race` passes. Multiple writers must both work and keep the LRU correct.
hints: Guard every access to the cache map and the LRU list with a sync.Mutex.
You may add a mutex field to KeyStoreCache.
Holding the lock for the whole Get() is fine for this exercise.
starterFails: starter.go writes to cache.cache and cache.pages without synchronization (-race detects the race)
referenceFixes: reference.go guards cache.cache and cache.pages with a sync.Mutex
